anomalies.title: Qualification profile can return process success for an experimental feature
anomalies.impact: A caller can mistake a numerical PASS for an accepted qualification verdict.
anomalies.resolution: RunVerdict is separated from numerical status and qualification rejection maps to exit code 4.

anomalies.title: J2 plastic tangent is not algorithmically consistent
anomalies.impact: Newton convergence and path-dependent response can be inaccurate.
anomalies.resolution: Direction-dependent consistent radial-return tangent implemented in engineering Voigt convention.

anomalies.title: PETSc backend is not a demonstrated distributed MPI implementation
anomalies.impact: Large unstructured multi-rank runs are outside the accepted domain.
anomalies.verification: Two-rank and four-rank distributed equivalence tests

anomalies.title: Newmark refactorizes a constant matrix and densifies initial mass
anomalies.impact: Transient runtime and memory grow unnecessarily with step count and model size.
anomalies.resolution: Reusable sparse LU introduced for the effective matrix and initial acceleration.

anomalies.title: Modal default permits unbounded dense conversion
anomalies.impact: A modal request can exhaust memory before producing diagnostics.
anomalies.resolution: Sparse eigsh default and configurable dense_modal_max_dofs guard.
